biggest_catch: Granny doesn't sell the cards — you buy through partners, so the discount and guarantee are the partner's, not Granny's.
catches: Savings, not income — only real on planned spending.
Granny aggregates partner deals; the actual purchase, delivery, and guarantee live on the partner's site.
Discount quotes can be stale at click-through (documented by reviewers).
Every new retailer purchase may require creating an account on that retailer's site.
Cash-reward amounts ($1-$2.50 seen on digital cards) are small per card — the value is in comparison, not the reward.

s6.note: 4 steps: search, compare, click through, buy.

steps: Search giftcardgranny.com for a retailer on your planned-spend list
Compare ranked discount offers and cash-back amounts across partners
Set a Gift Card Alert for brands you buy repeatedly
Click through to the cheapest partner and complete the purchase
Spend the card on the planned purchase
timing: Comparison is instant; card delivery per partner (typically within 24h for digital)
who_pays: Nobody pays you — savings only. Granny just helps you find the cheapest discounted card; the purchase completes on a partner site.
who_qualifies: Anyone; purchases complete on partner sites (which may require their own account).
work_available: GiftCardGranny's comparison is live, aggregating partner deals — but the actual purchase, delivery, and guarantee live on the partner's site.
what_gets_accepted: You're the buyer: Granny compares partner discounts, but quotes can be stale at click-through — always confirm the live offer on the partner site before buying.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Comparing is free; you pay the partner's listed discounted price. Unpaid time goes to comparison and possibly creating accounts on partner sites.
when_cash_arrives: No cash arrives — it's a discount realized when you spend the card. Card delivery timing is set by the partner (typically within 24 hours for digital).
